summary: All 8 files contain substantive formal mathematics in non-Archimedean functional analysis and spherical completeness. Each file contributes unique definitions, theorems, and proofs: Basic.lean (characterizations of spherical completeness, product stability, standard examples), Dense.lean (spherical density mechanism, ℂ_[p] counterexample), Ultrametric.lean (ultrametric transfer to quotients/completions/operators/lp spaces), Extension.lean (ultrametric Hahn-Banach via Zorn), Immediate.lean (immediate extensions, maximal completeness, Zorn construction), IsMOrtho.lean (orthogonal decomposition, finite-dimensional existence), LpQuotient.lean (spherically complete ambient via lp/c₀ quotient). DependencyExtractor.lean contains unique Lean metaprogramming for dependency extraction (not a pure import aggregator). No file meets the high evidence bar for hard exclusion under FILTER-002/004/007.
